title: Retail world models: code, configurations and results for two papers on retail forecasting
description:
Code, experiment configurations, run records and manuscript sources for two papers: World Models, Trees and Foundation Models for Retail Forecasting: Evidence from Four Public Data Sets (K. Iyer and M. Dabbeeru) and Auditing World-Model Explanations in Retail Forecasting: Faithfulness, Accuracy and Causal Validity (K. Iyer). The data sets (M5, Dominick's Finer Foods, Breakfast at the Frat, Corporación Favorita) are not redistributed; the code fetches them from their providers.
